SuttaCentral associates the topic of the text with canonical discourses on spiritual faculties (*indriya*), noting connections with two suttas from the *Indriya Saṁyutta*—the *Tatiyasaṁkhittasutta* (SN 48.14) and the *Paṭipannasutta* (SN 48.18)—as well as their Chinese counterpart in the *Saṁyuktāgama* (SA 652) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral lists one translation in one language for this text [SuttaCentral].
